description: Retrieve the full profile and complete parliamentary membership history of a specific MEP by their numeric CODICT identifier. Returns the MEP's name, date of birth, gender, and all committee, political group, intergroup, and delegation memberships with start/end dates and roles. Use the meps.list tool to look up MEP identifiers. Useful for understanding an MEP's committee responsibilities, political affiliations over time, and interparliamentary delegation work. Data source: European Parliament Open Data API v2 — CC BY 4.0, no auth required.

mep_id.description: Numeric MEP identifier from the European Parliament CODICT system. Example: 197539 for Mikuláš Peksa. Obtain IDs via the meps.list tool.

name: eu_parliament.meps.details

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.
